## review-bot — automated correctness review

The planning artifacts define strict per-agent Codex skill isolation, but the documented Codex skill-loading model includes additional skill scopes that are not excluded by the proposed environment setup. The test-only findings were dropped as coverage suggestions rather than concrete defects in this planning change.

**Result:** patch is incorrect (confidence 0.96) — 1 finding(s).

### Findings that could not be attached to a diff line

#### Codex cannot be restricted to only staged skills as specified
`openspec/changes/discoverable-review-agent-skills/specs/review-bot/agent-skill-registry/spec.md:541-541` (not attachable: line(s) [541] of `openspec/changes/discoverable-review-agent-skills/specs/review-bot/agent-skill-registry/spec.md` are not on the right side of the diff)

The contract requires Codex to discover only the owning agent's skills, but Codex also loads skills from bundled, system/admin, and repository scopes. A run on a host with such skills can expose additional instructions despite clean HOME/CODEX_HOME and staged skills, violating the isolation guarantee. See the published Codex skills documentation: https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills/.

**Suggested fix:** Define a supported mechanism that filters every Codex skill scope, or weaken the contract to account explicitly for unavoidable system or bundled skills.
